purpose: Summarize independently screened external island mechanism bridges without converting partial links, source availability, within-system replication, or repeated systems from one archipelago into a formal cross-system causal fit.

systems.strength: direct per-visit/service and reproductive-dependency evidence with floral response, but cross-year/cross-paper linkage
broad island-mainland visitation and direct autofertility plus reproductive-assurance and floral-transition recurrence, but no matched per-visit pollen function

one source-defined two-island system contains floral morph-state divergence, pollinator-environment contrast, single-visit pollen deposition and controlled reproductive dependence, but effectiveness/dependency are not matched on Dong Island
source-locked visitor-class single-visit reproductive outcomes and source-labeled autonomous breeding treatments in the same island study, but no matched floral-response transition

source-native signed bill-flower position predicts pollen-contact and nectar-robbing interaction quality; a closely overlapping contemporary lobelioid-bird study shows frequent robbing and altered nectar replenishment can coexist with high fruit and seed performance, but no same-tagged full chain or controlled reproductive-dependency estimate is available

the introduced honeybee-dominated system has a source-described physical stigma-access mismatch and unidirectional pollen transfer; published same-species intermorph hand-pollination fruit set is high in both directions while open fruit set is much higher in the accessible long-styled morph, but standardized single-visit effectiveness, numeric signed mismatch and controlled total dependency are missing

why_formal_fit_remains_closed: No external system yet supplies all mechanism links at a matched two-sided population/transition unit.
The six systems do not yet supply one compatible mechanism estimand family with source-locked uncertainty across at least two independent clusters.

Nicotiana has cross-year/cross-paper linkage, Caribbean Gesneriaceae lacks matched per-visit pollen function, Cordia lacks Dong-side direct effectiveness and controlled dependency measurements, Seychelles lacks a matched floral-response transition, Hawaii lobelioids lack a same-tagged full chain plus controlled reproductive dependency, and Ogasawara Psychotria lacks standardized single-visit effectiveness, numeric signed mismatch and controlled total dependency.

The Hawaii lobelioid bridge adds a propagation boundary rather than an additional independent geographic replicate beyond Hawaii; Ogasawara Psychotria does add a distinct Northwest Pacific geographic cluster.
Partial mechanistic recurrence cannot substitute for Issue #91 direct Izu field measurements.
reopen_rule: Reopen external bridge acquisition only when new lawful source-native material can close a named missing link in an existing partial system or provides a candidate matched floral-response, direct effectiveness, and reproductive-dependency transition with compatible uncertainty and hierarchy.
next_decision_gate: Issue #91 first real six-channel field bundle remains the active direct-Izu gate; external bridge work remains source-triggered. Ogasawara Psychotria is admitted from a named source trigger and should be used to test propagation versus buffering, not to reopen unconstrained acquisition.
claim_boundary: Six independent biological partial bridge systems strengthen the plausibility and generality of a branching/propagation architecture and reveal alternative mechanisms. Biological systems and geographic strata remain distinct counting units. The registry does not establish a universal island response, universal dependency coefficient, historical pollinator-loss causation, or a formal cross-system causal model.
